quotes.text: Wiring up a connector is nothing more than the invitation to the architecture party. The real event is figuring out how each layer interacts and how fragile things get when you try to scale up.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the episode's core argument that architecture, not the connector, decides success.

quotes.text: People hear that phrase prompt engineering and think it's just about typing better instructions, But it's more like tuning a search algorithm.

quotes.text: So the right AI configuration isn't just about making the solution work. It's about keeping business moving, cost predictable, and results sane.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: API management does things power automate and the connectors themselves can't. It enforces authentication and authorization every single time a request is made, not just when you remember to code it in.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why API Management is needed in front of AI endpoints.

quotes.text: Solid governance is the difference between an AI feature that fizzles out under pressure and one that grows sustainably as the business relies on it
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Makes the business case for treating governance as a core part of AI apps.

chapters.title: The real anatomy of AI in Power Platform
Tuning AI for sentiment, summaries and text generation
Securing the flow with Azure API Management
Governance for cost, compliance and control

takeaways: A production AI app in Power Platform has four layers: Power Apps or Dynamics 365 as the trigger, Power Automate for orchestration, the Azure OpenAI endpoint and Azure API Management as the guardrail.
Sentiment analysis, summarization and long-form generation need different prompts, models and token limits, so usage quotas and monitoring are essential to keep cost and latency under control.
API Management policies such as authentication, rate limits and logging, plus governance with resource tags, budgets and the CoE Starter Kit, keep AI features secure and sustainable as usage grows.
hook: Most AI demos in Power Platform stop at a connector and break as soon as real users, real data and real costs arrive. This episode shows makers and architects how to wire Power Apps, Power Automate, Azure OpenAI and Azure API Management into a secure, governed architecture that survives production.
